menu.name: Optional Rules
menu.label: Choose Optional Rules
menu.hint: How this world handles defeat and supports, and which of the Optional Modules it plays with.

additionalConditions.name: Additional Conditions
additionalConditions.hint: Adds the Additional Conditions of the Optional Modules to the conditions a unit can be given. Their durations and stacks are counted like any other; most of their effects are shown as reminders and left to the table.

turnGoldMost.name: Most Gold a map gives from a skill such as Income
turnGoldMost.hint: A skill that gives its unit Gold as its turns pass, such as Income, gives no more than this in one map. The Gold it has given so far is counted on the skill. Leave at 0 for no limit.

stolenGold.name: Gold stolen from an enemy that carries none
stolenGold.hint: A skill that steals gold from an enemy, such as Mug, takes the Gold on that enemy's sheet. This is what it takes from an enemy whose sheet has none.

cutIns.name: Skill cut-ins
cutIns.hint: As a skill takes effect, its icon and name flash over its unit before the numbers. Fast shows each more briefly. Off shows none, and skills are named in plain text as before. This is your own choice and changes nothing for the others at the table.

levelUpSplash.name: Level Up splash
levelUpSplash.hint: When a unit levels up, show its new level, its stats and what they gained over the whole screen, with a line from the unit. Off shows none, and the level up is told in chat as before. This is your own choice and changes nothing for the others at the table.

levelUpOnExp.name: Level up as soon as the EXP is earned
levelUpOnExp.hint: A unit that reaches 100 EXP levels up by itself, on the screen of the player it belongs to: its growth rates are rolled and the Level Up splash plays, or its promotion is offered. A unit no player owns levels up on the Game Master's screen. If its player is away, it waits until they join. Off leaves every level up to the Level Up button of the sheet, which works either way.

squareOpacity.name: Map squares: how solid
squareOpacity.hint: How much of the squares on the battle map is filled in, in percent: where a unit can move, what it can strike or reach, and what a foe threatens. Lower it to see the map under them: each square keeps its outline and a band of its colour. This is your own choice and changes nothing for the others at the table.

cutInSound.name: Cut-in sound
cutInSound.hint: Play a sound with each skill cut-in. It is as loud as Foundry's Interface volume.

cutInSoundFile.name: Sound of a skill cut-in
cutInSoundFile.hint: Which of the sounds that come with Foundry a skill cut-in plays, for everyone who has the sound on.

gmAnswers.name: Game Master's units answer by themselves
gmAnswers.hint: Some skills let a unit answer in the middle of a fight: dodge a hit, roll a miss again, soak a hit with a tome. A unit a player owns has its player asked, with one click and a short wait. With this on, units no player owns answer by themselves: they keep off or lessen a hit that would take a quarter of the HP they have left, roll a missed attack again, and come for an ally that would fall; they never end a fight early or trade a critical hit away. With this off, the Game Master is asked for them as a player is.

incapacitation.name: Incapacitation System
incapacitation.hint: Player units brought to 0 HP are Incapacitated instead of dying: hard hits cause Wounds, damage past 0 HP is kept, getting back up causes an Injury, and in the end the unit chooses between retreat and death. Units of other sides are simply defeated at 0 HP. With this off, every unit is defeated at 0 HP: it dies and leaves the map, and returns if it is raised above 0 HP or brought back from its sheet.

supportMethod.name: Support Points
supportMethod.hint: How supports grow: by hand, a point for each battle two partners are fielded in together (ranks at 2, 5, 10, 15 and 20 points), or points for what partners do together (a rank every 80). From A the two partners choose between A+ and S.

optionalAffinities.name: Optional Affinities
optionalAffinities.hint: Adds 27 more Affinities to choose from. Besides the usual boosts, their supports can give Critical, Critical Avoid, the Skill Activation rate, and HST (Haste), which counts as Attack Speed for making a follow-up attack and for nothing else.

affinityEffects.name: Additional Affinity Effects
affinityEffects.hint: Every unit gains the innate effect of its Affinity, for itself only, and the system applies all of them. Anima, Wood, Breath and Muscle are for their unit to use when it wants: switch them on from the Battle tab of its sheet or the Skill list of the Battle HUD. The rank Blade and Tome give is chosen in the Character Creator or on the Story tab, and the skill whose cooldown Key shortens on the Story tab.

heartSeals.name: Heart Seals and Reclassing
heartSeals.hint: A new unit chooses three classes which, with the class it starts in, are its Heart Seal Classes. From the Growth tab it can reclass into the line of any of them, at the tier it is in: its stats change by the difference between the two lines, proficiencies are traded, and it gains the new line's skills. A player spends a Heart Seal the unit carries; the GM needs none. Reaching the highest support rank offers one of the partner's classes. A Heart Scale adds one more class to the list, and a Second Seal reclasses into any class without adding it.

glory.name: Glory
glory.hint: A unit that brings down a unit with Glory to give gains that much Glory, set on the Optional tab of a boss's sheet. Glory is spent on that tab to unlock permanent Powers. The system applies most Powers by itself; a few are announced or listed in a fight for the table to apply, and a few are text only.

manualGains.name: Manual Stat Gains
manualGains.hint: A level up gives 3 points to place on stats, one to a stat, in place of the growth rolls; CON and MOV, where they can grow, take all three. Or keep the growth rolls, with 125 growth points at creation: a growth rate that comes up either lets its stat take a second point, or makes its one point worth two. The GM can change the number of points at each level up.

weaponLevel.name: Weapon Level
weaponLevel.hint: Units have a Weapon Level in place of rising weapon ranks: 5 to start, up to 30, with a growth rate of its own (up to 70%). In every weapon type a unit is proficient in it wields the weapons whose Weapon Level is no higher than its own. Proficiencies earn no wEXP once past F, so training weapons still work. The bonuses for mastering a weapon type come at Weapon Level 20 and 25.

skillCapacity.name: Skill Capacity
skillCapacity.hint: Units have 9 skill slots in place of 4, limited by Capacity Points: the Capacity Costs of the skills a unit has equipped may add up to 30, to 60 from the second tier, and to 120 from the third. A unit's own number can be typed on the Optional tab of its sheet.

alternateActivation.name: Alternate Skill Activation
alternateActivation.hint: Skills that roll to activate use their whole stat, whatever they divide it by: DEX/2% becomes DEX%, STR/2% becomes STR%. Or they roll at LVL%: the unit's level takes the place of DEX, and skills that use another stat use the whole of it. A flat chance such as 25% stays as it is, and the Skill Activation rate is still added.

combatArts.name: Combat Arts
combatArts.hint: Units learn Combat Arts, kept on the Skills tab of their sheet, and may ready one before they initiate a fight. An Art adds what its Effect says to the unit's first attack, and costs HP or Weapon Uses. Either the unit then makes that one attack, or it follows up as usual with only its first attack carrying the Art. The system applies the plain numbers of an Art and lists the rest of its text for the table.

battalions.name: Battalions & Gambits
battalions.hint: Units command Battalions, kept on the Skills tab of their sheet. A Battalion adds to its commander's numbers, loses HP with it and retreats at 0, and brings a Gambit: a special action with its own Hit and damage that cannot be countered and inflicts Rattled. Authority, a new proficiency, decides which Battalions a unit may command and grows as Gambits are used. Choose the rank Authority starts at.

breaking.name: Breaking and Extended Weapon Triangle
breaking.hint: Break: a unit that begins a fight with weapon triangle advantage and lands a hit that deals damage takes the counter-attack from its foe, for the rest of that fight and the foe's next one, or until the foe's next turn starts. Armored units are immune. The extended triangle gives more weapon types an advantage over one another, so that they can Break too: Brawl beats Bows and Crossbows, which beat Knives, which beat Brawl. Use both, or one without the other.

capturing.name: Capturing
capturing.hint: A unit may ready an attempt to capture before it attacks, on the Battle tab of its sheet or among its skills on the map. It needs more Weight than its target and fights with every stat but LUK halved. A target brought to 0 HP from next to it is captured and carried, which halves its captor's SPD and DEX; from further away it is subdued for its captor to pick up on its next turn. A target that cannot fight back is captured without a fight. A captive is out of the fight until it is released or its captor is defeated.

stagger.name: Stagger
stagger.hint: Every unit has a Stagger bar beside its HP, as large as 60% of the HP it has when a battle begins. The HP a unit loses comes off the bar too, except in a fight the unit began itself. A unit whose bar is empty is Staggered: it takes double damage from everything and cannot act until the end of its next turn, and then recovers with a full bar. Healing does not restore the bar, which regains 20% of its size as each of the unit's turns starts.

staffPassives.name: Passive Staff Effects
staffPassives.hint: A staff does something for the unit that has it equipped. A healing staff heals its unit for 5 + MAG/3 as each of its turns starts; a staff that inflicts a condition cures its unit of that condition then, and one that removes all conditions cures them all. Speed, Strength, Ensorcel, Barrier, Defense, Enfeeble, Empower, Freeze, Obscure, Blind, Crest, Haste, Anew and Expel raise a number of their unit instead, shown on its sheet under the staff's name.

healCriticals.name: Heal Criticals
healCriticals.hint: A staff that heals one unit may score a critical that heals for 3× the amount. The chance is LUK ÷ 2 %, rolled with each cast, and no skill changes it.

doubleCast.name: Double-Cast
doubleCast.hint: A staff that heals one unit may be cast a second time at once, like a follow-up attack. The chance is (DEX + SPD + LUK) ÷ 2 %. It is not rolled if the target is at full HP after the first cast. The second cast costs no further use.

staffMissing.name: Staff Missing
staffMissing.hint: A staff that is not used against an enemy can miss: it succeeds at its Hit + DEX × 3 %. A miss still spends a use. A staff for several allies, such as Fortify, rolls for each unit targeted. Staves used against enemies keep their own hit rate.

followUpCritical.name: Follow-up Critical Multiplier
followUpCritical.hint: Every unit has an FCM from 1 to 5, set on the Optional tab of its sheet. On a follow-up attack its Critical is multiplied by its FCM before the foe's Critical Avoid is taken off: a Critical of 5 becomes 10 with an FCM of 2. An FCM of 1 gives no bonus. A weapon that strikes twice gains nothing for its second strike, only for the strikes of its follow-up attack. Whether player units have more than 1 is up to the Game Master.

additionalLives.name: Additional Lives
additionalLives.hint: Player units have lives: 3, unless their sheet gives another total. Units of other sides have them when given a total. A unit that would be killed loses a life and leaves the battle instead, and is dead once none are left. Promoting adds one life and restores one.

additionalGrowths.name: Additional Growth Rates
additionalGrowths.hint: Adds CON and MOV growth rates, rolled on level up with the others. They count for at most 20% and 5%, and CON and MOV are capped at 30 and 20 unless a class or the sheet gives another cap.

movementStars.name: Movement Stars
movementStars.hint: Adds Movement Stars to units: 5% a star, up to 25%, to act again after an action, rolled from the Battle tab.

holyBlood.name: Holy Blood
holyBlood.hint: Adds the Holy Blood chart to units. Each lineage held adds to growth rates, doubled for Major blood, and raises the rank of its weapon by one, or to ★ for Major blood.

crests.name: Crests
crests.hint: Lets a unit bear a Crest, Major or Minor, whose chance to activate is rolled from the Battle tab. What the Crest does is applied by hand.

leadership.name: Authority & Leadership
leadership.hint: Adds Leadership Stars. Each star gives Hit and Dodge to its bearer and to the units that name its bearer as their Authority: either +10 to both within 3 spaces of the Authority, or +3 Hit and +5 Dodge anywhere on the map.

weaponKills.name: Weapon Kill Critical Bonus
weaponKills.hint: Weapons count the foes brought down with them. Each kill past 50, up to 100, adds 1 Critical while wielding that weapon.

levelCap.name: Level Cap
levelCap.hint: Units stop levelling at Level 60, unless their sheet gives another limit, as after a Seal of Eternity. A unit at its limit gains no further level and earns no EXP. The rulebook names no highest level; this is a rule of this system.

ConditionHint.oil: Takes effective damage from Fire. Burn chances against it are guaranteed and its stacks doubled.
ConditionHint.fear: Moves as far from enemy units as it can and ends its turn.
ConditionHint.sap: Loses 10% of its HP each turn, and the unit that inflicted this heals by the amount lost.

ConditionHint.beckon: Follows the unit that inflicted this as closely as it can, and does not act.
ConditionHint.idiot: MAG and RES are reduced to 0.
ConditionHint.sedate: Has a 50% chance not to act each turn.
ConditionHint.heavy: MOV is reduced to 1, and its stats are reduced by half its CON.
ConditionHint.zombie: Takes damage from healing staves, and counts as a Terror.
ConditionHint.feeble: STR and CON are reduced to 0.
ConditionHint.seduce: Out of control like Berserk, but attacks only its own allies.

ConditionHint.bedevil: Has a (31 − LUK)% chance to damage itself instead of its target in combat.
ConditionHint.expose: The next attack against it is a guaranteed hit and critical.
ConditionHint.squishy: DEF and maximum HP are halved.

ConditionHint.oblivion: Perishes at once if it does anything other than wait.

insight.name: Insight
insight.text: Increases the unit's MAG stat and cap by 1, and its growth by 5%.

fortitude.name: Fortitude
fortitude.text: Increases the unit's DEF stat and cap by 1, and its growth by 5%.

temperance.name: Temperance
temperance.text: Increases the unit's RES stat and cap by 1, and its growth by 5%.

prudence.name: Prudence
prudence.text: Increases the unit's DEX stat and cap by 2, and its growth by 5%.

justice.name: Justice

serendipity.name: Serendipity

gusto.name: Gusto

legerity.name: Legerity
legerity.text: Increases the unit's MOV stat and cap by 1, and its growth by 5%.

blueTears.name: Blue Tears
blueTears.text: +3 DEF and RES when at 25% HP or less.

greenTears.name: Green Tears
greenTears.text: +3 SPD and +5 DEX when at 25% HP or less.

flawlessEtiquette.name: Flawless Etiquette
flawlessEtiquette.text: Takes no penalties from Rescuing or Capturing and gives none when Rescued. Can Rescue without using an action, and allies can Rescue themselves into this unit's care.

triangulation.name: Triangulation
triangulation.text: Uses its highest Rank of any Proficiency when gaining Weapon Triangle Advantage, whatever the weapon type used.

void.name: Void
void.text: Randomly negates one of the foe's Skills at the start of combat, whether or not Nihil could negate it.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.text: When initiating combat and killing an enemy: +1d3 in the foe's highest non-HP stat for 2 turns.

adaptiveTactics.name: Adaptive Tactics
adaptiveTactics.text: +3 DEF against the physical weapon type that last dealt damage to the unit, and +3 RES against the magical weapon type that last did.

palisade.name: Palisade
palisade.text: Increases Block Chance by 10 and Shield damage reduction by 2.

smash.name: Smash
smash.text: When initiating combat, the unit can choose to push the foe back by 1 space after combat for every hit it lands.

chargeForth.name: Charge Forth
chargeForth.text: When initiating combat: +0.5 Damage, +2 Hit and Dodge, and +1 Critical and Skill Activation Rate on the first attack for every space moved.

deathlyAffliction.name: Deathly Affliction
deathlyAffliction.text: Increases all chance-based odds to inflict Conditions by 5%, or by 10% for Bleed, Poison, Burn, Frostbite, Brighten, Darken, Brand, Stumble, Damp, Squall, Rattled and Smoke.

encore1.name: Encore I
encore1.text: The unit gains a Movement Star.

encore2.name: Encore II
encore2.text: The unit gains a Movement Star.

encore3.name: Encore III
encore3.text: The unit gains a Movement Star.

spikewall.name: Spikewall
spikewall.text: 1×/turn, when taking damage: deals damage to the enemy equal to half of the unit's DEF or RES, whichever is higher.

affinityResonance.name: Affinity Resonance
affinityResonance.text: Gains its base Affinity boosts even with no support in range, and its Additional Affinity Effect if it did not have it already. Stacks with Zodiac, for a 2× multiplier to the base Affinity boost.

quickLearner.name: Quick Learner
quickLearner.text: Gains doubled wEXP, and an immediate E Rank in a Proficiency of its choice, or a Rank up in one if it already has E Rank or better in all.

bloodyArtistry.name: Bloody Artistry
bloodyArtistry.text: The unit's Combat Arts have their HP and Weapon Use costs decreased by 1. Stacks with Artist.

criticalEdge.name: Critical Edge
criticalEdge.text: Critical Hits deal ×3.5 damage instead of ×3.

qualityKiller.name: Quality Killer
qualityKiller.text: Deals 1.5× final damage to enemies with Special Qualities.

generosity.name: Generosity
generosity.text: Heals others for 50% more with Items and Staves.

rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenation
rejuvenation.text: Heals all HP when levelling up, and gains +1 in every stat that level raised for 1 turn. Stacks with Revitalize.

etherealStrikes.name: Ethereal Strikes
etherealStrikes.text: When initiating combat: can choose to target RES instead of DEF. 2 turn cooldown when used.

skillSavant.name: Skill Savant
skillSavant.text: +1 Skill slot. With Skill Capacity, also +20 Capacity.

rangemaster.name: Rangemaster
rangemaster.text: Can counter whatever its weapon's Range.

metalHeart.name: Metal Heart
metalHeart.text: Halves all incoming debuffs, and reduces the duration of every Condition longer than 1 turn by 1.

fudger.name: Fudger
fudger.text: 1×/turn: can reroll a missed attack roll, or force an enemy to reroll a successful attack roll against it.

triadTechnique.name: Triad Technique
triadTechnique.text: 1×/map: guarantees the activation of one of the unit's Proc% skills. Cannot be used against Bosses.

erosion.name: Erosion
erosion.text: Enemies this unit initiates combat against have their DEF and RES reduced by 10% for the rest of the map, up to 30% with successive initiations.

fullBloom.name: Full Bloom
fullBloom.text: Increases all of the unit's Growths by 5%.

killerEye.name: Killer Eye
killerEye.text: A fatal attack that would miss has a 50% chance to hit instead, if the unit has at least a 1% chance to hit.

immortal.name: Immortal

class.title: Class
class.lead: A new unit starts in one of the classes at the foot of the class tree. It takes the class's base stats, and you may raise or lower its Weight by up to 3.

sources.title: Charm and Intelligence
sources.lead: Choose the stat each is based on: DEX, SPD or DEF for Charm, and MAG, DEX or RES for Intelligence. You cannot use DEX for both.

skills.title: Starting Skills
skills.lead: Your class's starting Skill goes in your first slot; if it offers several, pick one. Every unit also starts with one Generic Skill.
skills.leadNoGeneric: Your class's starting Skill goes in your first slot. A Trainee starts without a Generic Skill, and takes one when it promotes.

ranks.title: Proficiencies
ranks.lead: D Rank in one weapon of your choice and E Rank in any others your class gives. All start at 0 wEXP.
ranks.leadLevel: A Trainee starts at {rank} Rank in every weapon its class gives. All start at 0 wEXP.

gold.title: Starting Gold
gold.lead: All units start with Gold to buy equipment with. Buy as much as you want within that limit; it is added to the sheet as you go.

bonus.title: Bonus Points
bonus.lead: Bonus points permanently increase your stats. No stat may rise by more than 2, and HP and LUK take 2 points for each point they rise.

growths.title: Growth Rates
growths.lead: Every Growth Rate starts at 10%. There are points to place as you like, and more that can only go to Charm or Intelligence. HP caps at 80% and the rest at 60%.

boon.title: Boon and Bane
boon.lead: If you want. A Boon raises a stat, its Growth Rate and its cap; a Bane lowers them. Take both or neither.

abilities.title: Ability Points
abilities.lead: Points for the higher of Charm and Intelligence to spread over abilities and saving throws, and a few more for saving throws only. An ability holds at most 5 + your level.

affinity.title: Affinity
affinity.lead: Your unit's birthsign. It sets the boosts you and those you Support give each other, for each level of the Support.

holyBlood.title: Holy Blood
holyBlood.lead: Growth bonuses and a weapon rank from a bloodline. It is gained at creation, allowed or bestowed by the GM.

heartSeals.title: Heart Seal Classes
heartSeals.lead: Three more classes which, with the class you start in, are the ones you can later reclass into with a Heart Seal.

crest.title: Crest
crest.lead: A chance-based ability that activates in combat. A unit bears one Crest at most, given by the GM at creation.

profile.title: Profile
profile.lead: With the mechanics out of the way, write down who they are, and your own boundaries as a player.

review.title: Review and Finish
review.lead: Everything in one place. Finishing puts the sheet in Play mode; the Creator stays in the header for whatever needs changing later.

Encounter.goneHint: The unit of this row was deleted from the world.
Encounter.single: A named unit: one of a kind.
Encounter.noForces: Nobody yet. Make an NPC, or add a unit of the world.
Encounter.addUnit: Add a unit of the world…

map.label: Map
map.generateHint: Opens the Map Generator. Pick the scene it makes here afterwards.
map.hint: Select a row under Forces, then click a tile.
map.hintGroup: Click a tile to have {name} stand there.
map.hintGoal: Click the space the Objective is about.
map.markHint: The space a Seize, Defend or Escape Objective is about.
map.scatterHint: Puts every group that stands nowhere yet somewhere open, clear of the deployment zone.
map.pick: Choose a scene with a square grid above, or generate a map, to place units.
map.blocked: That unit cannot stand on that tile.

seize.label: Seize or Arrive
seize.hint: A player character takes the Seize or Arrive action on a certain space.

rout.label: Rout
rout.hint: Defeat all enemies on the map.

boss.label: Defeat the Boss
boss.hint: Defeat the unit designated as the Boss.

survive.label: Survive
survive.hint: Survive a certain number of turns.

defend.label: Defend
defend.hint: Prevent enemies from ending their turn on a certain space.

protect.label: Protect
protect.hint: Prevent enemies from defeating a certain unit.

escape.label: Escape
escape.hint: All players take the Escape action on a certain space.

party.label: Party
party.empty: No unit of this world belongs to a player yet.
party.onlineHint: The units of the players who are logged in now.
party.onMapHint: The player units that stand on this encounter's map already.

read.nobody: Nobody is going yet. Tick the units that are, under Party, and the battle is read against them.
read.risk: Most at risk: {name}, whom {many} foes fell in {hits} hits.
read.riskOne: Most at risk: {name}, whom one foe fells in {hits} hits.
read.noRisk: No foe fells anyone in {hits} hits.
read.turnsHint: How many turns of attacks this party needs to fell every foe.
read.shareHint: The share of the party's HP the foes take in that time, after healing.
read.expHint: Kill EXP for every foe, at the party's average Level of {level}.
read.rowHint: Its Level against the party's average, and the Kill EXP that earns.

difficulty.label: For this party
difficulty.hint: A rough read, not a rule of the game. It strings the forecast together: the turns this party needs to fell every foe, and the HP the foes take from it in that time, less what its staves heal. Terrain and good play are not counted.
difficulty.none: No read yet: it takes a foe, and someone in the party who can attack.

check.none: No Objective is set: the map has no end.
check.bossMissing: Defeat the Boss needs an enemy marked Boss.
check.protectMissing: Protect needs a unit to keep alive. Pick it on its card.
check.unmarked: {objective} needs a space marked on the map.
check.recruit: {name} is recruitable: how is yours to rule.
check.noGrid: This scene has no square grid, so nothing can be placed on it.

unit.protect: This is the unit to protect
unit.loose: Stands nowhere yet. Click a tile on the map, or use Scatter.
unit.short: Not every copy finds a tile round where it was put. Move it, or lower the count.
unit.duplicateHint: The same unit again as a row of its own: to stand elsewhere, or to arrive later.

foot.onMap: {count} of its units are on the map.
foot.kept: Kept with the world as you go. Nothing is on a map yet.
foot.placeAsk: The {count} units this encounter put on the map are taken off first, with whatever happened to them. Place it again?
foot.placedLater: {count} units were placed. Still to arrive on a later turn: {later}.
foot.beginAsk: Begin {name}? Its units are placed if they are not yet, the map takes its Affinity and weather, and the Player Phase starts.
